purpose: Prospective repair of diagnostic oracle semantics; not battery source admission or repeatability acceptance
historicalAttempt08: Preserved frozen FAIL UID_CPU_FRESHNESS_MISMATCH; ORACLE_SEMANTICS_UNVALIDATED. Never reevaluate with this oracle.
scope: One short no-microphone diagnostic, approximately 90 seconds; no DORA recording

counter.type: ctf,A all-state first N counters only
counter.unit: milliseconds of UID CPU time by frequency, not energy
counter.basis: AOSP Android14 mCpuFreqTimeMs accumulates before wakelock redistribution. Forty-bin layout observed for earlier helper UID10276 while USB-powered. New worker UID10282 has no CTF in USB smoke; its availability during discharge is unproven and must pass fail-closed.
counter.oemBackend: NOT_PROVEN; candidate operational consistency will be tested, not assumed

preparation.helperStart: Only after physical USB unplug and verified paired TLS Wi-Fi reconnection
preparation.workerLifecycle: Normal force-stop of diagnostic worker and observer before each attempt, after prior receipt retrieval; no package data clear; no other packages touched
preparation.startState: Unplugged, Android thermal NONE, screen off, same firmware; no calls/media/user interaction
preparation.oneWorkerProcess: No sharedUid/no extra process in manifest; sampled numeric ps UID/PID must equal singleton worker PID at every boundary
preparation.identity: Package UID, worker PID and process-start elapsed time stable; signed provider permission and stable provider client
preparation.controls: Observer checks plugged/interactive about every 250ms while waiting; fail on observed violation. Boundary checks preserved. Periodic observations are not continuous proof of every possible transition.

workerWorkload: Pure arithmetic in separate thread; elapsed realtime deadline; no mic/files/network/wakelock and no Binder polling from CPU thread. Observer waits nominal duration before reading completion, checks its own power/screen state during wait.

boundary.order: observer begin -> worker before RPC call/worker timestamp/return -> dumpsys plus numeric ps -> worker after RPC call/worker timestamp/return -> observer end
boundary.contains: Both provider RPCs and dumpsys/ps; raw worker CPU and elapsed values retained
boundary.scopeLimit: Collection width is not proof that every model backend input is <=1000ms old

criteria.toleranceMeaning: Preregistered experimental threshold, not guaranteed OEM counter accuracy. Never widen after a mismatch.
criteria.quiescentWorkerCpuFractionMax: 0.05 of pulse raw UID CPU delta; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE_WORKER_LOAD
criteria.totalModeledLateDriftMax: max(2 * final printed quantum, 0.05 * modeled pulse delta)
criteria.componentLimitation: CPU-only consistency cannot override total modeled drift failure; secondary usage components are later separately timed snapshots, not reconstruction of an earlier pwi

future600SecondContract: OD2 target600000ms, measured monotonic boundaries <=1000ms uncertainty each, actual duration retained without normalization; unchanged
privacy: Only target UID/global version/epoch/frequency counters, diagnostic process lifecycle and controls. No audio/model/APK export, account data, device identifiers or network addresses in receipts.
independentReview: acceptance_review: no unresolved P0/P1/P2 after both parser findings fixed; scope clarification applied before seal
